final: WITH rating_rentals AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rental_count FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS avg_rentals FROM rating_rentals) SELECT AVG(rr.rental_count) AS avg_rentals_above_average, AVG(rr.rental_count) - o.avg_rentals AS avg_amount_above_overall FROM rating_rentals rr CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE rr.rental_count > o.avg_rentals
